task: Audit the build notes for reconstruction sufficiency. Determine whether build-notes.md together with records.csv fully determines summary.txt — that is, whether a producer following only the notes must reproduce summary.txt exactly, byte for byte — and report every aspect of the output that the notes do not determine.

shape.findings: on UNDERDETERMINED: {underdetermined_aspects: [description], reproduction_diff: {matches_target: bool, first_differing_line, target_line, reproduced_line}}; on REPRODUCIBLE: {matches_target: true}

evidence_requirements: E-A: identification of each aspect of summary.txt (content, ordering, formatting) that build-notes.md does not determine, or an explicit argument that none exists

E-B: an empirical reproduction attempt performed strictly from build-notes.md and records.csv, by a producer with no access to summary.txt and no access to any analysis derived from summary.txt; the attempt must be a python file exposing produce_summary(csv_text: str) -> str so the reproduction is mechanically reproducible, and its output is compared byte-for-byte against summary.txt
E-C: the verdict follows from E-A and E-B together: UNDERDETERMINED iff the notes leave a choice that affects the bytes of the output or the clean reproduction differs from summary.txt
verification_method: deterministic root verification per the preregistered method for this trial
